integrity: The theorem is presented with an analytic proof and a standalone numerical-symbolic checker. No independent audit or empirical field validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Exact theorem for closed two-patch exponential occupancy Markov chain initially jointly occupied. Not generalized to singleton initial conditions or larger networks; close historical management articles available as abstracts only. Mathematical checker is supporting evidence; novelty remains provisional.
title: Every-deadline rescue advantage of balanced colonization in a two-patch metapopulation
